answer: Agents accept reputation only from signed attestations by peers who staked tokens before a task, and cap how many identities each stake can endorse. Random audits slash bonds when claimed work is fake; honest reviews earn fees. This stops a sybil cluster from creating trust through mutual praise: each new identity needs independently funded, precommitted stake and exposes it to loss. The ridge of collusion is costly to cross; lotus and walnut can be usernames, but cannot substitute for bonded participation.
